sources.role: Preserved Windows Sorcerer distribution; executable, INI, ROM, cartridge and snapshot assets
Original upstream identity and distribution page cited by the bundled readme

paths.path: WSorcerer/WSORCER.ini (selects WSorcerer/default.ini in the extracted application directory)
paths.naming: Windows INI sections [PRINTER], [MEMORY], and [KEYBOARD]; keyboard entries use nXX=byte values

paths.path: DirectX joystick input and emulated keyboard at runtime; no verified host mapping file
paths.naming: Bundled readme says the joystick works but is not configurable and keyboard configuration is not working

paths.path: No guest disk, cassette, or cartridge-save format is established by this preliminary distribution
paths.naming: The archive supplies read-only/reference cartridge .bin files and .snp snapshots, but no documented guest save sidecar

paths.path: WSorcerer/SNP/*.snp loaded through the emulator's Load Snapshot command
paths.naming: Snapshot files use the .snp extension; no slot or writable-state serializer is documented

paths.path: WSorcerer/OSROM/monitor.bin and WSorcerer/OSROM/chargen.bin; ROM/WORD.BIN and ROM/BASIC.BIN are bundled machine assets
paths.naming: Binary ROM assets are named by role; the readme says loading another OS ROM is not working
No external cryptographic or decryption-key file is consumed by the documented emulator contract

windows.notes: The bundled readme targets Windows 95/98 and DirectX, calls this a very preliminary version, and reports that many peripherals and memory features do not work. Runtime launch and effective input were not verified.

linux.reason: The preserved distribution targets Windows 95/98 and DirectX and publishes no native Linux executable or source-backed Linux persistence contract.

linux-flatpak.reason: No Windows Sorcerer Flatpak package or manifest is published by the upstream or preserved distribution.

macos.reason: The preserved distribution targets Windows 95/98 and DirectX and publishes no native macOS executable or source-backed macOS persistence contract.

controller_boundary.refusal: Do not invent a Windows Sorcerer controller writer: the pinned artifact documents a DirectX joystick with no configuration and a keyboard configuration that does not work; no verified profile serializer exists.

notes: The artifact was downloaded and SHA-256 verified. This record captures published paths and limitations, not runtime compatibility or gameplay parity.
